vulnerabilities.title: SQL Injection in Authentication Route
vulnerabilities.description: Unsanitized user input in the username field allows unauthenticated SQL injection.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Use parameterized queries and prepared statements. Sanitize all user inputs.

vulnerabilities.title: Outdated Dependency: Insecure JWT Library
vulnerabilities.description: The JWT library used for session verification contains an algorithm confusion vulnerability.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Upgrade jsonwebtoken to version 9.0.2 or higher.

vulnerabilities.title: Missing Security Headers
vulnerabilities.description: The web server response headers lack 'Content-Security-Policy' and 'X-Frame-Options'.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Configure reverse proxy / web server to inject modern security headers.
